## Historical audit: H0150

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/runs/codex_parallel_12/lanes/codex_parallel_12_lane1/codex_parallel_12_lane1_I_r1/infer_logs/igel-persist-feature-schema/turn_1/trajs.json` (all event citations below). The original task prompt is not included in the supplied observations.

| Aspect | Evidence and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Goal | The task name suggests persisting an Igel feature schema; this is an **inferred goal**, not a visible specification. The student said it would trace training and inference, reproduce the issue, implement and verify a fix (main_agent event 1, chars [0,625)). |
| Autonomous exploration | The student inspected repository layout, Git state, feature-related locations, configuration, preprocessing, the server and Igel’s main implementation (events 2–19; notably events 7 [0,5636), 17 [0,8980), 18 [0,6101), 19 [0,63365)). The observed code converts dataframes to arrays and writes a fit description; these are baseline observations, not a demonstrated defect or fix (event 19 [0,63365)). |
| Blocker and changes | Git output showed detached HEAD at `bf4544d`, a `master` branch at that commit, and no remote output (events 7 [0,5636), 8 [0,670), 14 [0,2472)). The student reported that a branch from `main` was requested and asked for the intended base or remote (event 20 [0,767)); the underlying instruction is not visible. No edit or branch-creation operation appears. Inventory reports a zero-byte patch. |
| Validation and outcome | No reproduction or student-run tests are visible. Inventory reports **empty patch, formally not solved**, with fail-to-pass 0/24 and pass-to-pass 2/2; the underlying evaluation details are not supplied. The session ended normally with a clarification request, not a visible technical interruption (top-level metadata [0,4776); event 20 [0,767)). This is not evidence of a tested algorithmic failure or a partially implemented solution. |
| Teacher input | Archive paths list available hints and an after-round review, but neither their contents nor a delivered teacher message is visible. Metadata records zero teacher checks and zero wait (top-level metadata [0,4776)). Receipt and adoption are therefore **unestablished**; availability alone is not evidence of either. |

**Lessons and uncertainty.** Checking actual refs before following a branch instruction is transferable; stopping rather than assuming `master` left this particular task unimplemented. Whether the original instructions permitted an alternative base, what the precise feature-schema requirements were, and why each formal test failed remain unresolved. The trace does not establish whether a schema solution would have worked. This is a software task, not a scene audit.
